label: Corporate income tax rate on income up to $25,000
note: Bracket: $0 to $25,000 of North Dakota taxable income. Rates unchanged since 2015.

section: North Dakota corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate on income over $25,000
note: Bracket: $25,000 to $50,000 ($352.50 plus 3.55% of the amount over $25,000).
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Corporate Income Tax

section: North Dakota corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate on income over $50,000

source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Corporate Income Tax

section: North Dakota corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Additional tax for water's-edge filers
note: Extra 3.5% (described officially as a surtax) on North Dakota taxable income for corporations electing the water's-edge method.
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Corporate Income Tax

section: North Dakota property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Counties, cities, townships, school districts and other taxing districts; counties bill and collect
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Property Tax

section: North Dakota property tax: state rules
label: State oversight
value: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner (state supervisor of assessments) and the State Board of Equalization
note: The State Board of Equalization equalizes local assessments and values centrally assessed property such as railroads, pipelines and utilities.
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: State Board of Equalization

section: North Dakota property tax: state rules
label: Residential taxable value
note: Taxable value of residential property is 4.5% of true and full value; local mills are applied to taxable value.
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Residential Property Tax

section: North Dakota property tax: state rules
label: Primary Residence Credit
note: State-funded credit against property tax on an owner-occupied primary home; apply each year January 1 to April 1. No age or income limits.
source_title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner: Primary Residence Credit

section: North Dakota real estate transfer tax
label: Real estate transfer tax
value: None: the North Dakota Constitution bars the State and local governments from taxing the transfer or mortgage of real property
note: Article X, Section 27 also prohibits mortgage taxes.
source_title: North Dakota Legislative Branch: Constitution of North Dakota, Article X (PDF)
